Network: GET /api/admin/observability/system-health status 403 (network.json:95-97) and GET /api/admin/observability/interrupteurs status 403 (network.json:122-125). without role=alert. Sidebar on both E states hasEtatDuSysteme=false (PHP AppLibrary.php:183-188 maps observability/* → settings).
findings.why_real: Two APIs 403 on the same deep-link, Vue still mounted, sidebar correctly hides the item. SyncOverviewController.php:63-69 role:Admin|Tenant Admin on systemHealth.
